topic: Can an intervention green the Sahara sustainably, and what happens afterward?

assumptions.note: Illustrative scenario inputs; not measured Sahara needs or a validated vegetation model.

story_premise.subject: Sahara and the systems that sustain vegetation
story_premise.place: Sahara; Ounianga used as a scoped opening example
story_premise.period: Contemporary hypothetical intervention; past climate is a comparison
story_premise.subject_opening: Freshwater lakes and their hidden water supply, then the different climate of the past
story_premise.mission_introduction: After subject exploration, grant a fictional coalition a sustainable Sahara-greening mission
story_premise.objective: Green the Sahara sustainably without depleting its supporting water or abandoning long-term costs
story_premise.success_criteria: Durable vegetation at mission scale with a verified sustainable supply and continued operation; a pilot alone does not meet the full objective
story_premise.baseline: Present conditions; groundwater and past vegetation do not establish a future self-sustaining supply
story_premise.divergence: Hypothetical intervention; no historical event is rewritten as fact
assumptions: A1: bounded authority and present technology
A2-A4: illustrative area, net need and water cap
resources: Survey and pilot authority with consent
constraints: Soil, drainage and maintenance not waived
decisions: Do not book speculative rainfall as supply
story_premise.outcome_reason: Under the granted inputs the mission-scale sustainable supply and expansion have not been established; the illustrative pilot already consumes the cap before additional needs
consequences: If deployment preceded cancellation, used water/materials and site obligations persist
Data or suitable smaller infrastructure may retain conditional value
Separate success branch B1 still has maintenance and allocation demands
Large success branch requires investigation of dust/nutrients and remote climate links
story_premise.uncertainty: The main verdict is conditional on these inputs; it does not prove greening impossible under every future scenario. B1 is an additional grant, not a measured success.
story_premise.hypothetical_frame: Fictional coalition introduced after exploring the subject

shot_context.basis: Conditional persistence of installed equipment and obligations
shot_context.uncertainty: Illustration; no measured damage extent or authentic project photograph
